summary: Phase 3 ContentMenu rollout regression test. Backend regression: 17/17 pytest pass (community-highlights/top continent filter, diary report_type, 5/hr rate limit, my-reports). Frontend: critical issue — the ContentMenu component does NOT render on the new Phase 3 surfaces (visit-detail photo overlay, visit-detail diary header, feed.tsx per-card). Verified via DOM inspection that 0 aria-label='More options' elements exist on a non-owner visit-detail page (admin viewing fake_user_43528211's Arc de Triomphe visit) and 0 such elements exist on the social-tab community feed even after scrolling to non-own items (e.g. Arc de Triomphe by Olav Strand). Owner-side regression OK (own visit shows long-press hint, Add Photo, share/edit toggles, no ContentMenu). The /community page, Profile menu row, Social hero compactness, and Explore-no-CTA regressions all continue to pass.

ui_bugs.issue: On a non-owner visit-detail page (admin viewing visit_ca8a3b6799b4 by fake_user_43528211 — Arc de Triomphe), the overlay ••• menu does NOT render on the main photo. DOM inspection: 0 elements with aria-label='More options' on the entire page; 0 data-testid attributes anywhere. Owner-side (visit_4f32a4eaf670) correctly hides the menu and shows the long-press / Add Photo affordances, so the !isOwner gating is being reached but the component output never reaches the DOM. Hypothesis: combination of (a) data-testid prop being silently dropped by react-native-web (RN-Web requires testID, see separate item) AND (b) accessibilityLabel not surviving — no aria-label appears either, which is unusual since social-tab pages do produce aria-labels. May also be a z-index collision with photoCountBadge which is positioned at the same top:8/right:8 corner of the photo (lines 312-317 vs 318-331).

Social-tab community feed cards do NOT show the ••• menu on non-own items. After scrolling to load feed (admin's view), card 'Arc de Triomphe / Olav Strand / 3 ❤' is visible but the rightExtra slot only shows the upvote chip — no ellipsis-horizontal icon. Total social-tab DOM has only 4 aria-labels, 0 of which are 'More options'. The wiring at feed.tsx:385 looks correct in source but the rendered DOM has no menu trigger.

Could not exercise because the seeded fake_user visits in preview DB have diary=null/diary_notes=null. The diary section header therefore isn't rendered (line 521 gate). Recommend seeding a public visit with diary_notes set so a non-owner test can verify the subtle ••• in the diary header.

integration_issues.flow: ContentMenu data-testid testability across the app
integration_issues.issue: ContentMenu.tsx lines 114, 136, 147, 157 pass `data-testid={...}` as a JSX prop to <TouchableOpacity>. React-native-web does NOT pass through arbitrary HTML data-* attributes on RN components — the canonical RN prop is `testID` (camelCase) which RN-Web auto-converts to data-testid in the DOM. As-written, all four data-testid attributes are dropped, breaking automated test selectors AND test wiring on production web. Fix: rename `data-testid` → `testID` on every TouchableOpacity in this file. Same anti-pattern is also used on visit-detail.tsx line 606 (data-testid='comments-section') — this attribute is not in the rendered DOM either.

Spec: 'When owner, only see share-toggle + edit buttons; when non-owner, only see ContentMenu.' Actual code (lines 659-706): the share-toggle (eye icon) and edit-pencil <TouchableOpacity> are rendered UNCONDITIONALLY inside the same flex row. Only the ContentMenu is gated by `user?.user_id !== visit?.user_id && visit?.diary`. Result: a non-owner viewing someone else's country visit will see ContentMenu + share-toggle + edit-pencil all together. Tapping edit on a non-owned visit will open the edit dialog and PUT against /api/country-visits/{id}, which the backend will reject — but the UX is broken either way. Fix: wrap lines 671-706 in an isOwner ternary and render ContentMenu in the non-owner branch.

issues: If the ContentMenu render bug is fixed, the overlay ••• at top:8/right:8 will collide with the existing photoCountBadge which is also positioned top-right of the photo. Recommend offsetting one of them (e.g., shift photoCountBadge to bottom-right, or shift ContentMenu to top-left) to avoid visual stacking.

Visibility chips (Public / Friends Only / Private) render and look interactive on a non-owner page. The press handler (handleChangeVisibility) likely no-ops or 403s at the API but the UI gives the impression of editability. Pre-existing, but noticed during this test.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/components/ContentMenu.tsx — uses `data-testid` JSX prop on RN TouchableOpacity. RN-Web silently drops unknown HTML attributes on RN components; the canonical prop is `testID`. This single mistake breaks every Phase 3 + Phase 1+2 testid selector reachable through this component (8+ selectors).

/app/frontend/app/country-visit-detail/[country_visit_id].tsx lines 671-706 — share-toggle and edit-diary buttons are rendered without an isOwner check. They sit right next to the ContentMenu which IS gated, producing inconsistent UX for non-owners. Spec violation.

rca of the issue: PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/components/ContentMenu.tsx uses `data-testid` as a JSX prop on react-native TouchableOpacity. React-native-web (used by Expo on web) does not forward arbitrary data-* attributes to the underlying DOM element on RN components — the canonical prop is `testID` (camelCase) which RN-Web converts internally to data-testid. This explains why DOM inspection finds 0 data-testid attributes on every page that uses ContentMenu. SECONDARY OBSERVATION: even the accessibilityLabel='More options' is absent from the visit-detail DOM (0 aria-labels page-wide) which suggests the entire ContentMenu component is not entering the render tree on visit-detail. Possible causes: (1) JS runtime error in ContentMenu's child components (ReportModal, theme import) suppresses render, (2) some prop type mismatch breaks the gate. Reproduction: login admin, navigate /visit-detail/visit_ca8a3b6799b4 (Arc de Triomphe by fake_user_43528211), inspect DOM — no aria-label='More options', no ••• visible at top-right of photo (only the photoCountBadge '2' is visible). Mitigation: rename data-testid → testID throughout ContentMenu.tsx; verify no JS error in browser console when the page loads; add z-index/position offset to avoid photoCountBadge overlap. The country-visit-detail share/edit ungated bug is independent — fix by wrapping lines 671-706 in isOwner ternary.
